Article 1 (Matters to Be Observed by Spectators)
Persons attending a court hearing as spectators shall comply with orders of the presiding judge for maintaining the dignity and order of the courtroom and with instructions issued by court employees under the presiding judge's orders. <Amended on December 29, 2006.>
